preconditions.description: The number of parcels is between 1 and 500, inclusive.
The strength of the platform is between 0 and 1000, inclusive.
The weight and strength of each parcel are between 0 and 1000, inclusive.
The value of each parcel is between 1 and 10^6, inclusive.
The arrival and delivery times of each parcel are valid and within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: For any i and j (i ≠ j), ini ≠ inj or outi ≠ outj
preconditions.description: The arrival and delivery times of each parcel are unique.

postconditions.expression: Jaroslav can get a maximum sum of money
postconditions.description: The output is the maximum amount of money Jaroslav can get by delivering parcels at the specified times.

invariants.expression: The total weight of boxes on the platform at any time does not exceed the strength of the platform S
invariants.description: This invariant ensures that the platform's strength is respected at all times.

invariants.expression: The strength of any box on the platform is no less than the total weight of the boxes above it
invariants.description: This invariant ensures that the platform's stability is maintained.
